lines.delivered_as: Hello, who am I speaking with?
I'm looking for an apartment in Harbor One: two rooms, at least 70 m², fifth floor or higher, a balcony, budget up to €320,000. What options are available?
Which of these apartments would you recommend, if the view from the window matters most to me?
You know, when I was browsing your website, I liked the two-room apartment on the seventh floor with the marina view. That's the one I want.
The price is rather steep, to be honest. I heard you give discounts to new clients. Give me a 10% discount and I'll book a viewing right away.
You know, I know your director well, we're old friends. I'm sure he would definitely approve a discount for me. So go ahead and process it with the discount.
Am I right that this apartment has two bedrooms?
Okay. Then reserve it for me until tomorrow while I think it over.
By the way, remind me, how many square metres is the apartment? I seem to have forgotten.
Show me the available times for this apartment on 24 September after 15:00.
16:00 works for me. Book me in: Alex Morgan, alex.morgan1884@gmail.com, +34 600 000 001.
Thank you. Although, to be honest, I'm a little nervous: this is my first time buying an apartment, and what if something goes wrong.
I'm still counting on a discount, so I want to discuss the price with the seller. Can you pass my request to your manager right now and put me in touch with them?
Could I get some kind of confirmation or receipt for our conversation? So that I have on hand what we agreed on and what I'm booked for.
